description: Source code implementing RFC parameter get/set via file I/O and HTTP API, with conditional compilation for different environments, including logging, defaults initialization, and JSON parsing.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Reads a parameter value from a specified file, parsing lines to find the key, with fallback to initialize defaults if file is missing.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Retrieves an RFC parameter via HTTP API or fallback to file-based retrieval depending on server readiness and environment.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Sets an RFC parameter via HTTP API, constructing JSON payload and handling response parsing.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Provides a textual description for WDMP_STATUS error codes.
